intent.message: The export defect requires an audit, and the fix is estimated at two periods while six periods of core work remain; delivering both at normal capacity is not sustainable without reprioritization.

I need clarity on whether the demonstration can use a reduced scope, since the deadline is for a demonstration and reduced scope works only if explicitly agreed (demo_acceptable). Sales promised an extra feature before technical capacity was confirmed (promise).

note: Small smoke evaluation; not a general quality benchmark. Costs estimated from reported usage, not billing invoices.
